results.title: Ajit Agarkar, Gautam Gambhir reminded Mohammed Shami 'still has cricket left' after being ignored despite Bumrah's injury
results.description: Mohammed Shami's coach sends a strong message to Gautam Gambhir and BCCI selectors, confirming the veteran pacer has shed 5kg and is ready for an India comeback.
